job: Tell customers whether the product works now, what is being done about it and how each part has done for 90 days.
purpose: A public page with no app shell: the brand and Subscribe, the overall status in one line with a tile in its tone, the open incident or maintenance with its updates on a timeline, every component with its state and a 90-day fd-heatgrid strip (60 or 30 days where 90 would not fit) and its uptime, scheduled maintenance, and past incidents by day, folded. One reading column; one fd-states wrapper switches loading and error.
useWhen: Customers and their agents need one public address that says whether the product works.
An incident or planned work affects some components, and people want its updates without signing in.

avoidWhen.when: The people reading it are operators who post the updates.
Only the signed-in product needs to show its health.
The page shares one result or piece of evidence, not live health.

states.name: operational
states.how: ?state=operational, or the Demo state band; every component reads Operational and no incident card shows

states.name: degraded
states.how: ?state=degraded, the default; one component Degraded and the open incident with its updates

states.name: outage
states.how: ?state=outage, or the Demo state band; two components in outage and the incident in the danger tone

states.name: maintenance
states.how: ?state=maintenance, or the Demo state band; maintenance in progress in place of an incident

states.name: loading
states.how: ?state=loading, or the Demo state band; first paint shows it for about 600 ms; fd-states data-state="loading"

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error, or the Demo state band; fd-states data-state="error" with Try again
